adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb the job does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and then passes that content into `TopicEmbed.import(...)`. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and Post#cook returns `raw` directly for `:raw_html` (skipping the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline). This means HTML entities like `<script>...</script>` from a feed are decoded into live `<script>` markup and stored/rendered as raw HTML (e.g., embed view uses `<%= raw post.cooked %>`), enabling XSS from feed content.
